entry.title: adidas x Metalwood SS26 Lookbook

Discover adidas and Metalwood's first collaborative capsule collection...

More
entry.content:
Starring Collin Morikawa, Austin Itri, Delon Isaacs and Sean Kim | Shot by Ryan Thomas Murray | Los Angeles, CA

Carlsbad, Calif. – February 16, 2026 – adidas and Metalwood Studio are dropping a limited capsule that brings street style to the first tee. The limited range inspired by the unapologetic Y2K fashion era offers distinctive silhouettes drawing from an eclectic group of genres: skateboarding, fashion and golf. The exclusive range will be available in limited quantities beginning Thursday, February 19 at https://metalwood.studio and Friday, February 20 on the CONFIRMED app, adidas.com and select retailers. 

The collaboration merges adidas performance and heritage with Metalwood’s street-inspired fashion aesthetic, resulting in a limited-edition capsule that brings bold styling to the course. The intentionally curated assortment focuses on 6 pieces: a polo, windbreaker, pant, hat, glove and exclusive MC70 golf footwear.

The hero product in the range is a golf pant that features a zippered ventilation in the leg that reveals 3-Stripe detailing. There are subtle nods to mid-2000s adidas Teamgeist designs in the polo, and the MC70 footwear includes deco-stitched detail in the leather upper inspired by football boots from the 1970s.

Shaun Madigan, Global Director of Apparel, adidas Golf said: “We saw tremendous success when we combined the fashion and skateboarding communities with our Rolling Links collection in the fall of 2024. We wanted to dive deeper into these communities and felt Metalwood was the perfect partner to bring another chapter like this to life. The result is a perfect blend of adidas and Metalwood to inspire all golfers with additional ways to style their look for the course.”

Cole Young, Founder, Metalwood added: “adidas is the only brand that can combine fashion, sport and streetwear in such an iconic way, but while still maintaining the aesthetic that we offer fans of Metalwood. I’m really proud of where the pieces in this range landed and can’t wait for both Metalwood and adidas audiences to appreciate them.”

As part of the launch, adidas and Metalwood present a brand film that follows a relatable foursome as they scramble to get to their tee time. The film highlights pieces from the range and includes cameos by adidas athletes Collin Morikawa and Nora Vasconcellos. 

The adidas x Metalwood range will be available in limited quantities beginning Thursday, February 19 at https://metalwood.studio and Friday, February 20 on the adidas CONFIRMED app, adidas.com and at select retailers. 

About adidas

adidas is a global leader in the sporting goods industry. Headquartered in Herzogenaurach/Germany, the company employs more than 62,000 people across the globe and generated sales of €23.7 billion in 2024. 

About Metalwood Studio

Metalwood Studio is an ode to golf in the ‘90s and some of the early 2000s–the technology boom is just starting to happen. The pros of yesteryear are trading in their persimmon woods and balata balls for something a little faster and more aggressive. They’ve exchanged flares and 4-button placket polos with the baggiest, frumpiest shit they could find; long before the yoga-but-make-it-golf clothes of today.
Metalwood aims to preserve this iconic look and feeling by offering a shoppable experience. We look to engage with our visitors by creating a nostalgic wormhole via a collection that includes vintage-inspired clothing, accessories and golf equipment.

KEEN and Metalwood Studio Tee Up Golf Footwear Collaboration
New pre/post-round collection brings iconic KEEN comfort to courses everywhere.

Portland, Oregon—KEEN, Inc. (KEEN), maker of original hybrid footwear, and LA-based golf streetwear brand Metalwood Studio have paired up to create the ultimate pre- and post-golf shoes. It’s KEEN’s foray into the golfing world, but it's not the first time golfers have worn KEEN sandals as their après shoe.

“Our partnership with Metalwood came about organically, as the team there had already been wearing KEEN sandals before and after golfing,” says Masaki Takagi, KEEN Sr. Global Merchandising Director. “We love that Metalwood is broadening the scope of golf and making it more inclusive, accessible, and sustainable. These are values we share at KEEN.”

The collab collection includes limited-edition versions of the Hyperport Clog and UNEEK II Convertible – both selected with relaxation and balance in mind. The Hyperport Clog is a hyper-light and airy slip-on born from KEEN’s hyper-versatile hybrid sandal that features maximal cushioning and an ultra-grippy sole. The UNEEK II Convertible is also known for versatility. This open-air sneaker features an adjustable heel strap to convert from a shoe to a slide. With the Hyperport Clog in ethically sourced suede and the UNEEK II Convertible in cords that minimize waste, they are Consciously Created for less impact on the planet.

Metalwood’s inspiration for the design comes from golf course typography maps as well as reflexology – “how the contours of the nervous system relate to our emotions on and off the golf course,” says Metalwood Founder Cole Young. The design also features bespoke Metalwood branding.

Key features of the Hyperport Clog include:

  • Airy cushioning: Injected foam midsole is extra thick and light for a more cushioned experience.
  • Maximized grip: High-grip zones in KEEN Aquagrip rubber provide better traction on wet surfaces.
  • Roomy toe box: Generous space across the forefoot for toes to spread out.
  • Ethically sourced leather: Premium suede leather from tanneries certified by the Leather Working Group for their environmental and social practices.
  • KEEN.PROTECT toe protection: The iconic KEEN rubber toe bumper has been keeping toes safe since 2003.
  • Easy-adjust strap: Cinch down or loosen up the webbing strap to dial in your fit.
  • Pesticide-free odor control: Eco Anti-Odor fights foot funk with natural probiotics that are safe for human health and the environment.

Key features of the UNEEK II Convertible include:

  • Adaptable fit: Free-moving, two-cord upper has infinite points of adjustability, so it conforms to the shape of your foot.
  • Easy-cinch bungee: Quick-cinch bungee system lets you personalize the fit.
  • Convertible design: The adjustable heel strap can be pulled forward to convert to a slide.
  • 100% recycled upper: Lightweight and breathable two-cord upper is made from 100% recycled P.E.T. plastic. hyperport
  • Minimal waste construction: The unique cord design eliminates the waste associated with die-cut uppers.
  • Long-lasting cushioning: Resilient foam insole with arch support stays supportive.
  • Slip-resistant grip: Razor siping in the tread channels water away for increased grip in wet conditions.
  • Pesticide-free odor control: Eco Anti-Odor fights foot funk with natural probiotics that are safe for human health and the environment.

This limited-edition Hyperport Clog is available for $160 USD in men’s sizing, and the all-gender UNEEK II Convertible is available for $150 USD, at www.keenfootwear.com and
https://metalwood.studio.

Starring Kurumi Yoshimoto & Phil Nisco | Shot by Ryan Thomas Murray | Lake Arrowhead, CA

About KEEN
Family-owned and values-led for over 20 years, KEEN is striving to make the most original, durable, Consciously Created footwear on the planet and using its business to do good. In 2003, KEEN started a revolution with the introduction of the original hybrid sandal, the Newport – combining the openness of a water sandal with the toe protection of a rugged shoe. KEEN has continued to create industry-changing innovation for life outside on trails, jobsites, sidewalks, and water. Its KEEN.FUSION-constructed Targhee IV hiking boot was awarded a Best Invention of 2024 by Time Magazine for its revolutionary durability. KEEN has been PFAS free since 2018 and is taking everything it
knows as a conscious shoemaker and putting it in service of people and the planet – sharing its sustainable innovations to do more good together. Learn more at keenfootwear.com.

About Metalwood Studio
Metalwood Studio is an ode to golf in the '90s and some of the early 2000s. The technology boom is just starting to happen. The pros of yesteryear are trading in their persimmon woods and balata balls for something a little faster and more aggressive. And they’ve exchanged flares and 4-button placket polos with the baggiest, frumpiest shit they could find; long before the yoga-but-make-it-golf clothes of today. Metalwood aims to preserve this iconic golf look and feeling by creating a nostalgic wormhole via a collection that includes vintage-inspired clothing, accessories and golf equipment.

entry.content:
Maxfli®, a golf brand with a century-long legacy in performance and quality, has partnered with Metalwood Studio to unveil a limited-edition apparel collection. Reimagining classic golf aesthetics through a modern lens, the collection, Maxfli by Metalwood Studio, will launch on Metalwood Studio’s online store on Sunday, October 6th and at the Metalwood Studio location in Los Angeles on October 10th.

Metalwood Studio, known for its unique blend of golf-infused streetwear, draws on the 1990s and early 2000s golf culture and tech boom. The collection evokes nostalgia with pieces that honor golfers and their distinctive style. By merging Maxfli’s storied history with Metalwood Studio’s bold, fashion-forward ethos, the collection offers something special for both dedicated golfers and fashion enthusiasts, making a statement both on and off the course.

"This collaboration celebrates Maxfli's rich history in golf in a new way," said Sara Scarlett, Maxfli Brand Manager. "Metalwood Studio is the ideal partner for this collection because of their unique ability to stay rooted in golf culture while staying ahead of modern fashion trends. Their fresh, innovative approach to highlighting nostalgic golf style within their designs perfectly complements Maxfli’s legacy of performance and style."

The design process was a true collaboration, with Maxfli offering access to its archives while giving Metalwood Studio the creative freedom to reimagine the brand's iconic imagery. The collection includes a hooded sweatshirt, crewneck sweatshirt, tech vest, polo jerseys, graphic short sleeve t-shirts and variety of snapback hats. Each piece in the collection is custom cut and sewn, avoiding the use of blank items to ensure the highest quality.

"I’ve always admired Maxfli as a heritage brand in golf," said Cole Young, Founder of Metalwood Studio. "This collaboration allowed us to dig deep into Maxfli’s long history and reinterpret its legacy for today. Drawing my inspiration from my own collection of vintage golf magazines with old Maxfli ads, we’ve created something that honors the brand’s past but with a fresh take for today’s audience. It’s a nod to those who know the history of Maxfli and to those who are discovering it for the first time through this collection."

As Metalwood’s largest co-branded project to-date, this collection integrates Maxfli’s legacy with Metalwood’s distinctive design resulting in apparel that is both authentic and modern.

Starring Chapin Rudd | Shot by Ryan Thomas Murray | Los Angeles, CA

entry.content:
FootJoy has partnered with insurgent, vintage-inspired golf label, Metalwood Studio, creating a Limited Edition version of the Golf Sneaker. This limited version features premium, hand-selected imported leather atop FJ's Duramax outsole.

To some, the Golf Sneaker might not look all that different from your dad's shoe du jour. "We chose to work on the Golf Sneaker because we saw an opportunity to showcase how truly versatile this style is. It's an extremely comfortable and high-performance golf shoe. It's really up to our audience to wear it in ways that fit their own personal style. Take my dad for example. He's not a golfer. But ever since my hands and feet grew to be the same size as his, all of my hand-me-down gear went to him. To this day, he still uses my old golf gloves and golf shoes to mow the lawn because he likes the 'added traction.'"

The Metalwood x FootJoy Golf Sneaker becomes available on Jul. 30, 2024 @ 11AM PST exclusively at Metalwood Studio.
